customManagers.description: Agent CLI versions pinned in values.yaml via a renovate marker comment.
Tool versions pinned in the image Dockerfile via ARG + marker comment.

packageRules.description: jdx/mise-action stays on the floating major tag (@v5) instead of a digest pin: the digest churns on every patch release and floods the PR queue.
Action and hook bumps are exercised by CI on the PR itself, so green checks are enough to merge them.
Non-major updates merge on green CI; 0.x versions break on minor bumps, so they stay manual.
The image and chart are the agents' runtime (home volume, optional cluster RBAC); a bad tool binary or base image there is a compromise, not a broken build, so they get read.
Agent CLIs are what the workspace exists for; bump them via PR, never auto-merge.
